Otherwise reuse original research, proposal, Stage 6a critical assessment, full canonical-plan save and clean independent review/main adjudication before retrying. Pending review/save never authorizes implementation of an unreviewed revision. No arbitrary iteration or three-no-progress stop/advance rule applies; bounded individual-operation retries, ownership and safe independent recovery remain. Retain recovery and completion publication/ingestion without duplicate empty commits. Each stage assesses its own goals against fresh actual evidence, creates missing work, updates verified gaps or retains satisfactory work, and hands off outcomes and unresolved obligations. Reconcile all remaining required work and proof in the existing numbered Implementation or retrospective Tasks layout, preserving completed work, immutable original work identities, blockers and applicable evidence. At stage 4, validate the selected local plan and branch against the exact plan_path handoff. Reconcile merge, publication and ingestion results before repeating side effects. Simple numbered plans remain simple through Stage 11 and recovery; already structured/resumed plans stay structured. Stage 11a normally converts simple plans only after positive Stage 16 completion, before downstream native review/repair/proof loops. Preserve accepted testing restrictions and procedures as scoped non-checkbox prose in relevant simple items/story notes or existing structured Testing sections, carrying them unchanged into structured sections at Stage 11a; equivalent wording is sufficient and adequate existing wording stays intact. Stage 19 accepts that legitimate prose without a positive testing-item count; missing/empty sections or no tests exist is not an exclusion. Required native 19a retrospective and 23a/23b-pr implementation, local/PR review and repair cycles remain enabled; a human-only testing restriction does not skip a whole child. Retain real target/scope/ownership, active/unknown-writer and no-race safeguards in existing operations. Stage 19 routes only on task format, with native 19a when conversion is needed and 19b when format is usable. Stages 23a and 23b-pr are direct native steps when reached; their existing review/repair responsibilities remain. Native inputs remain data, not instruction forwarding. Human testing remains external/pending, never a pass or missing agent proof. Flow definitions are cached per root: source edits do not hot-reload a running definition. This cache behavior is user information, not a native-launch proof prerequisite. Actual operations retain their safety and ownership checks; invocation is not acceptance proof. Child failure or outer lifecycle ok never establishes completion. Native resolution retains running-repository-first/configured-default fallback, real child owner/source and T3 Code working folder.
